subject.title: fix(llm): share one rate-limit window policy across session and failover retries (alt to #103200)

question: After the classifier defect and proof gap are fixed, should the canonical repair share rate-limit window policy across session and embedded failover, or remain session-local through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103200?
rationale: The choice changes permanent ownership across the session retry surface introduced by `steipete` and the failover window policy introduced by `lanzhi-lee` and recently maintained by `gorkem2020`; automation can repair the defect but cannot choose that boundary.

options.title: Adopt shared policy
options.body: Land this design after it represents unknown windows explicitly, adds both consumer regressions, and provides real runtime proof.

options.title: Adopt focused fix
options.body: Land the narrower session-only correction and defer shared ownership to a separate owner-approved refactor.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared policy
recommendation.body: Land this design after it represents unknown windows explicitly, adds both consumer regressions, and provides real runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the session retry classifier that owns the reported user-visible bug and is the strongest available coordinator for the cross-path decision.
